test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F is an immediate neighbour of A. D sits second to the right of E. B is an immediate neighbour of E and sits second to the right of C. F sits second to the right of D. A is not an immediate neighbour of E. Who sit between E and A from the right of A?
solution: **Given :** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. **Explanation : ** 1) D sits second to the right of E. 2) F sits second to the right of D.
